D: A boy hides a stranded alien in his house and helps him get home.
P: Lay out a trail of peanut butter chocolates when Elliott lures E.T. into the house.
S: Halloween caramel popcorn and lolly mix
the trick or treat walk, E.T. under a sheet

Oven-baked caramel popcorn tossed with chocolate buttons, jelly lollies and roasted peanuts, piled up like a trick or treat haul. Heat the oven to 120°C. Pop the corn and tip it into a large roasting tray. Melt the butter with the brown sugar and golden syrup, boil for 4 minutes, then stir in the bicarb and a pinch of salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool, break up and toss with the chocolate buttons, jelly lollies and peanuts.
Cheddar crackers cut into letters, for the day E.T. learns English
Cheese crackers cut into letters with small cutters: cheddar, butter and flour, rolled thin, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
M: Pepperoni pizza in squares, as Michael's friends wait on the pizza man
Pepperoni pizza on a hot steel at max heat, cut into squares for the family.
Elliott's toasted ham and cheese triangles
the day he frees the frogs

Leg ham, Swiss cheese and a smear of mustard butter toasted in a pan until golden and melting, cut into triangles with crunchy apple slaw. Mash 60g soft butter with 1 tsp mild mustard. Butter the outsides of 8 slices of white bread. Fill each pair with 2 slices leg ham and 2 slices Swiss cheese. Toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted, pressing down with a spatula. Toss 2 grated apples and 1 grated carrot with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Cut the toasties into triangles and serve with the slaw.
W: Milk chocolate cups filled with sweet peanut butter
Melted milk chocolate in cupcake liners, a spoon of sweetened peanut butter, more chocolate on top, chilled to set.
Peanut butter discs in candy melts, like Reese's Pieces
Homemade peanut butter chocolate buttons: peanut butter, icing sugar and butter rolled into small discs, dipped in coloured candy melts.
K: Root beer over vanilla ice cream with a drizzle of chocolate syrup

Ice-cold root beer poured over big scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, foaming up to the top, with long spoons and straws. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes. Add 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream to each glass. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each glass so the foam rises without spilling over. Top with a drizzle of chocolate syrup and serve straight away with long spoons and straws.

steps.text: Beat the peanut butter, icing sugar and soft butter until smooth.
Roll into small discs and chill until firm.
Melt the candy melts gently, dip each disc and set on baking paper.
Lay them in a trail across the table.
Heat the oven to 180C. Pulse the cheddar, butter, flour and salt until it looks like crumbs.
Add a splash of water and pulse until it forms a dough.
Roll thin and cut into letters with small cutters.
Bake on lined trays until crisp and golden.
Cool on the trays so they crisp up.

s.note: Cheddar crackers cut into letters, for the day E.T. learns English
s.how: Pulse 150g grated cheddar, 60g cold butter and 100g flour with salt until it forms a dough, adding a splash of water. Roll thin and cut into letters with small cutters. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.

m.note: Pepperoni pizza in squares, as Michael's friends wait on the pizza man
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce and top with 250g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake on a steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 to 8 minutes, then cut into squares.

w.how: Melt 300g milk chocolate. Spoon a little into 12 cupcake liners and chill. Mix 150g peanut butter with 50g icing sugar and put a spoon on each. Cover with the rest of the chocolate and chill until set.
